chapters.label: Live: Uragan v Araz
chapters.text: A 2021 Futsal Champions League night in Ukraine. Uragan play Araz. Fareniuk is the pivot, the player up front. He scores the second goal, and Uragan win two one!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: A pivot links the team’s play. This is how he does it: he shows for the pass, plays it back, spins away, gets it back and scores!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. The defender watches the ball, so nobody follows his spin!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: show for the pass, then play it back and spin away!
